mutants.label: #9a [control] membership test written as an equivalent chain of inequalities
mutants.why: The membership test `quadrature not in QUADRATURES` becomes `quadrature != 'registered' and quadrature != 'adaptive'`. For every input, str or not (None, a list, bytes, True), `in` on a two-name tuple is the same two equality tests, so the same values are rejected and the message still formats QUADRATURES. Inert over every call; it would matter only if QUADRATURES gained a third name, when the chain would have to grow with it.

mutants.label: #9b the accepted tuple is reordered (adaptive first)
X1 [control] render_curve's own quadrature check removed (render_row repeats it)
mutants.why: render_curve checks the quadrature once up front, and its first call to render_row -> sky_xyz checks it again with the same function, the same ValueError and the same message; SUN_ELEVATIONS is never empty. So every caller sees the same exception from the same entry point. Inert while only the quadrature is wrong; with an out-of-domain v1 atmosphere AND a bad quadrature the domain error would now come first, and no test combines the two.
